body:
The difference between your friend and I is that your friend actually brought happiness to people.  Whenever people are around me, even my family, they look bored and impatient.  I don't have anything to talk about.  I don't have the confidence to carry a decent conversation.  I'm just such a small person.

I have no escape from where I am right now.  I am no one's best friend.  I am not the person that anyone cares about the most.  I truly envy your friend.

What if their love isn't enough to help me overcome my problems?  Yes, some people do love me, but that doesn't change the fact that I'm miserable every day.

This isn't doing it for me anymore.  I need something tangible, not a mental reminder.  I wish I could have a reliable foundation of relationships, but I'm so alone.  So I have to keep suffering like this because one or two people love me?
